description: Payout Vault Research Hypothesis Registry v4.0 — corrected component hypotheses PV-H01 to PV-H14 as required, plus additional hypotheses. All nulls are NET_EXPECTANCY_AFTER_COSTS <= 0. Frequency policy corrected: low frequency alone is not a rejection rule.
breakeven_win_rate_note: At 3R, breakeven win rate = 1/(1+R) = 1/4 = 25%. After $7.50 RT cost on a typical 20-tick stop ($10 risk), cost adds ~0.75% to breakeven, giving ~26%. Primary null is NET_EXPECTANCY_AFTER_COSTS <= 0.
primary_null_note: Win rate is secondary. The primary performance null for all component hypotheses is that net expectancy after round-trip costs is zero or negative.
minimum_sample_rationale: 100 trades provides ~80% power to detect a 10% win-rate improvement at alpha=0.05 (one-sided binomial test). For sub-group analyses, minimum 50 per group.

low_frequency_action: Calculate expected annual sample size from observed weekly frequency
Assess whether available historical sample is sufficient for valid inference
Continue basic event-outcome and expectancy analysis where statistically possible
Assess diversification and portfolio utility at low frequency
Do not promote the setup to paper or live trading
Classify as INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE if total historical events < 30
Classify as LOW_PORTFOLIO_UTILITY if frequency < 1 per month
halt_conditions: Total historical event sample is insufficient for valid inference (< 30 events)
The detector is not reproducible across two independent runs
The definition is unstable across sub-periods
The occurrence has no positive incremental evidence after exhaustive analysis
frequency_policy.note: Low weekly frequency alone is not a statistical rejection rule. Research continues with appropriate sample-size caveats.

hypotheses.name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal vs Matched Non-Sweep Baseline
hypotheses.description: Bars that qualify as a liquidity sweep (wick penetration of a prior swing extreme) followed by a reversal have a positive net expectancy after costs, compared to a matched baseline of non-sweep bars at the same price level.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Wick penetration of prior swing extreme (AMB-04 primary)
hypotheses.baseline: Matched non-sweep bars at same price level and time of day

hypotheses.name: CSD Incremental Value After a Liquidity Sweep
hypotheses.description: Adding the CSD confirmation filter (P-05) to a liquidity sweep event improves net expectancy after costs compared to the sweep-only baseline.
hypotheses.primary_definition: CSD window = 3 bars, full-range midpoint (AMB-01 primary, AMB-09 primary)

hypotheses.name: Fake MSS Filtering Incremental Value
hypotheses.description: Excluding fake MSS events (fMSS, where a sweep occurs but no subsequent MSU is confirmed) from the setup improves net expectancy after costs compared to including all sweep events.
hypotheses.causal_detector: P-02 detect_msu (fMSS = absence of MSU after sweep)
hypotheses.primary_definition: fMSS = sweep followed by no HH+HL (bullish) or LH+LL (bearish) within 10 bars (AMB-02 SOURCE_EXPLICIT)
hypotheses.baseline: All sweep events without fMSS filter

hypotheses.name: FVG Retracement Entry vs Confirmation and Next-Bar Entry
hypotheses.description: Entry Type 2 (limit order at FVG proximal edge after CSD) has a higher net expectancy after costs than Entry Type 1 (market order at next bar open after CSD).
hypotheses.primary_definition: Entry Type 2 = limit at FVG proximal edge (AMB-08 primary)
hypotheses.baseline: Entry Type 1 (next bar open after CSD)
hypotheses.reject_rule: net_expectancy(type_2) <= net_expectancy(type_1) AND sample >= 50 per type
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per type OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: SMT Confirmation Incremental Value
hypotheses.description: Setups with SMT divergence confirmation (P-07) have a higher net expectancy after costs than setups without SMT confirmation.
hypotheses.primary_definition: SMT = NQ/MNQ divergence at swing extreme (AMB-08 in previous registry, now formalised as part of P-07)
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per group OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Higher-Timeframe DOL Alignment Incremental Value
hypotheses.description: Setups where the LTF sweep direction aligns with the HTF DOL direction (P-01) have a higher net expectancy after costs than setups where they are misaligned.
hypotheses.baseline: All full-sequence setups regardless of DOL alignment
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per group OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Inducement Incremental Value
hypotheses.description: Requiring a prior inducement event (P-03) before the sweep improves net expectancy after costs compared to sweep-only events.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Inducement = prior swing extreme swept before the main DOL sweep (SOURCE_EXPLICIT per R-07)
allowed_alternatives: Inducement = any prior swing within 20 bars
hypotheses.baseline: All sweep events without inducement filter
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per group OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Fixed 3R vs Alternative Exits
hypotheses.description: The fixed 3R exit (P-10) produces a higher net expectancy after costs than alternative exit strategies (trailing stop, time-based exit, partial profit at 1R).
hypotheses.primary_definition: Fixed 3R: target = entry + 3 × risk, no early exit (SOURCE_EXPLICIT per R-21)
hypotheses.baseline: Best-performing alternative exit strategy on validation period
hypotheses.pass_rule: net_expectancy(3R) > 0 AND net_expectancy(3R) >= net_expectancy(best_alt) AND p < 0.05

hypotheses.name: Session Dependence
hypotheses.description: The full-sequence setup has a materially different net expectancy after costs during the London session (03:00–05:00 UTC) versus the New York session (13:30–16:00 UTC).
hypotheses.primary_definition: London = 03:00–05:00 UTC, NY = 13:30–16:00 UTC (SOURCE_EXPLICIT per R-28)
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(net_expectancy_London - net_expectancy_NY) <= $5 AND sample >= 50 per session
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per session OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Volatility-Regime Dependence
hypotheses.description: The full-sequence setup has a materially different net expectancy after costs in high-volatility regimes (ATR-14 above 75th percentile) versus low-volatility regimes.
hypotheses.primary_definition: High volatility = ATR-14 (5m) > 75th percentile of trailing 20-day ATR
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(net_expectancy_high - net_expectancy_low) <= $5 AND sample >= 50 per regime
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per regime OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Trend-Regime Dependence
hypotheses.description: The full-sequence setup has a materially different net expectancy after costs in trending regimes (ADX-14 > 20) versus ranging regimes.
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(net_expectancy_trend - net_expectancy_range) <= $5 AND sample >= 50 per regime
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per regime OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Full-Sequence Incremental Value
hypotheses.description: The complete 4-step setup (DOL + inducement + sweep + CSD + FVG entry) has a higher net expectancy after costs than any individual component alone, demonstrating that the full sequence adds unique value.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Full sequence = all 4 steps required (R-01 through R-24)
hypotheses.baseline: Best-performing individual component from PV-H01 to PV-H07
hypotheses.pass_rule: net_expectancy(full) > net_expectancy(best_component) AND net_expectancy(full) > 0 AND p < 0.05

hypotheses.name: Loss-Condition Discovery
hypotheses.description: There exist identifiable market conditions (regime, time, price context) under which the full-sequence setup has a materially negative net expectancy after costs, enabling a loss-avoidance filter.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Loss condition = any sub-group with net_expectancy < -$30 per trade and sample >= 30
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: No identifiable sub-group has NET_EXPECTANCY_AFTER_COSTS < -$30 with sample >= 30
hypotheses.pass_rule: At least one sub-group with net_expectancy < -$30 AND sample >= 30 AND p < 0.05
hypotheses.reject_rule: No sub-group with net_expectancy < -$20 across all tested dimensions

hypotheses.name: Portfolio Overlap and Complementarity
hypotheses.description: The Payout Vault full-sequence setup has a trade overlap rate of less than 30% with the existing Atlas Nexus models (A1, B1, SB1, ORB-1), and adds positive incremental Sharpe ratio to the portfolio.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Overlap = same 5m bar entry as any existing model trade
allowed_alternatives: Overlap = same session day as existing model trade
Overlap = within 3 bars of existing model trade
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Trade overlap >= 30% OR incremental portfolio Sharpe <= 0
hypotheses.baseline: Existing Atlas Nexus portfolio (A1, B1, SB1, ORB-1) OOS performance

hypotheses.name: Setup Frequency Assessment
hypotheses.description: The 4-step setup occurs with sufficient frequency for statistical inference. Frequency is assessed but low frequency alone does not halt research.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Frequency = number of qualifying setups per trading week on OOS dataset
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Setup frequency < 2 per week (LOW_FREQUENCY classification applies)
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: setups_per_week < 2 AND total_historical_setups >= 30 (LOW_FREQUENCY — continue with caveats)

hypotheses.name: Direction Asymmetry
hypotheses.description: Bullish setups and bearish setups have materially different net expectancy after costs on MNQ.
hypotheses.primary_definition: Bullish = sweep of prior swing low, bearish = sweep of prior swing high
hypotheses.reject_rule: abs(net_expectancy_bull - net_expectancy_bear) <= $5 AND sample >= 50 per direction
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: sample < 50 per direction OR p >= 0.05 AND p < 0.10

hypotheses.name: Temporal Stability
hypotheses.description: The full-sequence setup win rate is stable across time: at least 3 of 5 walk-forward folds show positive net expectancy after costs.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Fewer than 3 of 5 walk-forward folds show NET_EXPECTANCY_AFTER_COSTS > 0
hypotheses.baseline: Random walk (expected 2.5 of 5 folds positive by chance)
hypotheses.inconclusive_rule: profitable_folds == 2 of 5 OR any fold has sample < 20

hypotheses.name: Parameter Sensitivity
hypotheses.description: The full-sequence setup net expectancy after costs is not materially sensitive to the primary parameter definitions (within the pre-registered alternative ranges).
hypotheses.primary_definition: All 7 primary definitions (AMB-01, AMB-04, AMB-05, AMB-06, AMB-07, AMB-08, AMB-09)
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Net expectancy varies by more than $30 across the pre-registered parameter space
hypotheses.reject_rule: max_expectancy_variation > $50 AND driven by a single parameter

experiment_plan.name: Detector Integrity and Event-Frequency Scan
experiment_plan.description: Run all 11 detector primitives on the full canonical dataset. Verify determinism (run twice, compare SHA). Count qualifying full-sequence setups. Classify frequency. Assess sample sufficiency.
experiment_plan.frequency_policy: LOW_FREQUENCY classification if < 2/week. INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE halt if total < 30. Otherwise continue.
experiment_plan.gate: MANDATORY — halt only if total events < 30 or detector is non-reproducible
